Completed the reviser stage. The final proposal covers every released-plan clause and explicitly resolves C-01, C-02, and C-03. Loro remains a provisional prototype candidate; its Rust API describes commit as history/event grouping, not durable storage or an ACID transaction ([Rust API](https://docs.rs/loro/latest/loro/struct.LoroDoc.html)). Application and concurrency validations are proposed, not run.
